def solve(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    ones=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(I) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==1]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for p in [(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(I) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==2]:
        if p in seen: continue
        st=[p]; comp=[]
        while st:
            q=st.pop()
            if q in seen: continue
            seen.add(q); comp.append(q)
            i,j=q
            for di,dj in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                n=(i+di,j+dj)
                if 0<=n[0]<H and 0<=n[1]<W and I[n[0]][n[1]]==2 and n not in seen: st.append(n)
        comps.append(comp)
    for c in comps:
        rs=[p[0] for p in c]; cs=[p[1] for p in c]
        for a in ones:
            # horizontal band of 2s aligned to a one
            if len(set(rs))==1 and a[0]==rs[0]: hit=True; break
            if len(set(cs))==1 and a[1]==cs[0]: hit=True; break
        if hit:
